description: Regression corpus of representative 68K + AREXX doors. Each entry runs via web/backend/src/scripts/run-amiga-door.ts (or the AREXX-direct path), stdout is captured + diffed against goldens/<id>/output.txt. Adding a door: drop it into Doors/, register here, run with --capture to freeze the golden, then run without --capture to verify it stays green.

doors.name: Sent_FE
doors.notes: Banner-only stub door (EMPiRE/MYSTiC X-DESiGN 1994). Loads, renders ANSI banner, issues PRV_COMMAND 'Sent', shuts down. No input expected — pure outbound trace test for XIM JH_REGISTER → SV_NEWMSG → DT_NAME → DT_SLOTNUMBER → BB_NONSTOPTEXT → JH_SM* → PRV_COMMAND → JH_SHUTDOWN sequence. Verified 2026-05-11.

doors.name: Conftop
doors.notes: Conference Top Uploaders v2.3 (Bobo/Mystic + Looby/Insane). Exercises XIM banner + dos.library file I/O for Conf.DB reads + AEDoor message flow. Without Conf.DB seed data, exits early with 'Reset date is out of range' — stable trace either way. Verified runs to completion + emits banner 2026-05-11.

doors.name: WHO v2.0
doors.notes: WHO v2.0 by Spy/MST. Renders who's-online header banner then queries active nodes. Exercises XIM BB_MAINLINE / ACTIVE_NODES / MULTICOM ops + DT_SECSTATUS user-field path. Non-interactive, exits cleanly. Verified deterministic 2026-05-12.

doors.name: AquaWho
doors.notes: Aqua who's-online listing. Exercises XIM data-query path (DT_NAME/DT_LOCATION/DT_LINE_NO) for all nodes. Non-interactive — renders list and exits.

doors.name: 5D-AutoFree V0.01
doors.notes: SvEN/5D 1994 file-check / auto-free door. Without its full .info tooltype set, the door's icon.library GetDiskObject lookup fails and it exits with 'Door hasn't been started fully right!' Pinned here as a deterministic 5-XIM-op trace (JH_REGISTER → SV_NEWMSG → BB_MAINLINE → JH_WRITE × 2 → JH_SHUTDOWN). Surfaced by bulk-probe 2026-05-12.

doors.name: 5D^DupeCheck 0.10
doors.notes: 1.7 KB tiny SvEN/5D 1994 upload-dupe detector. Same icon-config exit path as 5D-AutoFree but with a distinct AEDoor message ordering. Pinned to catch any regression in the BB_MAINLINE return path on minimal doors.

doors.name: 5D-DoorMenu
doors.notes: 5D-DoorMenu — door-selection menu, prompt '<CR>=quit'. Scripted Enter drops out. Exercises XIM JH_HK + JH_SF (Show File).

doors.name: 5D-TimeBank
doors.notes: 5D-TimeBank — time-deposit/withdraw door. 'Q' hotkey quits per its UI hint. Exercises XIM DT_TIMELIMIT + RAWARROW + JH_HK input path.

doors.name: LOGOFF v1.2
doors.notes: LogOff v1.2 by Steve and DR. G of Italian Bad Boys '93. Confirms 'do you really want to LogOff (y)es/(N)o/(r)eply ?' — 'n' declines + door exits. First door in corpus to exercise JH_BBSNAME (BBS name query) and DT_NAME together with the hotkey path.

doors.name: 5D-ZippySearch II v0.11
doors.notes: 5D-ZippySearch by sTc/5D. Line-input prompt 'Enter string to search for >:'. Bare Enter aborts the search and exits the door. Exercises XIM JH_LI (line-input) path — first corpus door to cover that op.

doors.name: Bull (5150-B10)
doors.notes: Bulletin update door from 5150-B10. Prompt 'Update bulletins? (y/N):' — 'n' declines and exits. Minimal 3.9 KB binary — useful for pinning the JH_HK hotkey path in isolation (no other XIM ops fire).

doors.name: ConfScan v2.6 (68000)
doors.notes: ConfScan v2.6 — conference scanning utility. Exercises ENVSTAT (environment-status query), DT_CONFACCESS (conf access flags), and BB_CONFNUM (current-conf number). Non-interactive, clean exit. Three novel XIM ops in one door.

doors.name: uPdOWNiNFO v1.2
doors.notes: uPdOWNiNFO v1.2 — upload/download stats info screen. Exercises DT_STAMP_CTIME (account creation time) + BB_CONFNUM + the full DT_BYTES* / DT_DAILY* user-data field set. 20-op trace, non-interactive.

doors.name: easystatus (D93)
doors.notes: Damage93 easystatus — 24-op status renderer with embedded current-time field. Restored 2026-05-12 with the time-mask runner pass.

doors.name: ConfStats v1.3 (Tough Stats by Json)
doors.notes: ConfStats v1.3 'Tough Stats' by Json — 31 XIM ops, highest single-door op-count in the corpus. Renders 'Local time...' line that previously drifted; restored 2026-05-12 with time-mask runner pass.

doors.name: newinfo (AFL_PACK)
doors.notes: AFL_PACK newinfo — heaviest XIM trace in the universe sample (27 ops). Covers the entire user-data + sysop + BBS-info query surface. Non-interactive.

doors.name: 5D-Status V1.50
doors.notes: 5D-Status V1.50 by SvEN/5D — third user-stats variant (23 ops) with NODE_DEVICE query that the others don't issue. Pinning all three (newinfo + easystatus + 5d_status) catches per-variant query-ordering regressions.

doors.name: FuckNature (DIVE-FNA)
doors.notes: Dive's FuckNature — 20-op trace. Distinct fingerprint from the other status doors; different rendering path. Non-interactive.

doors.name: JoinCnf 3.6
doors.notes: JoinCnf 3.6 — third-party conference-join helper (independent of the BBS's internal `J` command). Non-interactive — renders + exits.

doors.name: RatioReport 1.7
doors.notes: RatioReport 1.7 by Captain Caveman (30th). Exercises file-ratio reporting path.

doors.name: AutoOnline 1.2
doors.notes: EMPiRE AutoOnline 1.2 — auto-online activity bulletin. Different category from status doors (status writer not reader).

doors.name: Conference Security AmiXDoor V1.30
doors.notes: C+N Conference Security V1.30 — checks access on conference join. Different XIM surface from JoinCnf (access-check vs join-action).

doors.name: S!X Stat V2.0
doors.notes: S!X Stat V2.0 from LGC — 29-op status renderer, distinct fingerprint from U-Stat/newinfo/5D-Status.

doors.name: sKAN^4^sTATUs
doors.notes: Insanity sKAN^4^sTATUs — 28-op status door, again distinct fingerprint.

doors.name: Super-Stats (Intellect)
doors.notes: Intellect Super-Stats — 19-op variant. Different from the 5D family — broader Amiga-doors-scene coverage.

doors.name: AFL Status
doors.notes: AFL status door — exercises NODE_UNIT + `Unknown (907` (an XIM op our XIMCommand enum doesn't name yet — useful for catching when we DO name it that the trace stays stable). 23 ops total.

doors.name: AFL Pager
doors.notes: AFL pager — exercises JH_SF (Show File) screen-display path + RETURNCOMMAND. First corpus entry covering JH_SF.

doors.name: HoldCheck (Kero/BTH)
doors.notes: Kero/BTH HoldCheck — exercises JH_CO (Console Output) + JH_SO (Serial Output) — two distinct XIM output ops the rest of the corpus doesn't cover. Pinned to catch any regression in low-level output routing.

doors.name: diary (AEXSETU)
doors.notes: diary door from AEXSETU — exercises JH_SG (Show GFile) + JH_EF (Edit File). First corpus entry covering the file-editor XIM path.

doors.name: Bulls (mgs!)
doors.notes: mgs! bulls bulletin-list door — exercises DT_TIMEOUT + BB_LINECOUNT (line-counted page output).

doors.name: MST wall.000 (Write-on-Wall)
doors.notes: MST wall door — prompts 'Write On Wall (y/n)?' — declines, exits. Represents a 5-door y/n cluster from the bulk-probe timeout-cluster miner (wall.000/.010/.020/.030 and variants). One corpus entry pins the JH_HK y/n input path for the cluster.

doors.name: CDTrans (CD transfer)
doors.notes: CDTrans — CD-ROM file transfer helper. Prompts 'Filename(01):' — bare Enter aborts, door exits. Represents a 5-door 'Filename:' line-input cluster (CDTrans/CD_DL.EXE variants).

doors.name: 5D-FileId (SIM)
doors.notes: 5D-FileId — pure SIM batch (no XIM ops, no AEDoor handshake). Exercises dos.library file open/read/write path against the door's config file. First SIM-category corpus entry.

doors.name: MAKECMD (SIM)
doors.notes: dRE!NEW_PUB MAKECMD — SIM utility for building command sets. Different LVO mix from 5D-FileId.

doors.name: 5D-News (SIM)
doors.notes: 5D-News — news bulletin generator (SIM batch). Pinned alongside 5D-FileId/MAKECMD as a third zero-XIM regression coverage point.

doors.name: 5D_Comment (SIM)
doors.notes: 5D_Comment — sysop-comment helper (SIM batch). Fourth SIM corpus entry — different code patterns than the 5D-FileId/News doors.

doors.name: U-Stat V1.0
doors.notes: U-Stat v1.0 by S¡eGeL/AFL (graphics by aRGøN/AFL). User-stats info screen — exercises 29 distinct XIM ops in one door including the entire DT_* user-data field family (DT_LOCATION, DT_UPLOADS, DT_BYTESUPLOAD, DT_DOWNLOADS, DT_BYTEDOWNLOAD, DT_SECBOARD, DT_SECLIBRARY, DT_DAILYBYTELIMIT, DT_DAILYBYTEDLD, DT_STAMP_LASTON, DT_TIMESCALLED, DT_MESSAGESPOSTED, DT_TIMETOTAL, DT_TIMEUSED, DT_EXPERT) + JH_SYSOP / EXPRESS_VERSION / BB_CONFNAME / BB_NODEID / BB_TASKPRI / NODE_BAUDRATE. Scripted \r after 4 s exits cleanly. Pinning this catches any regression across the user-data XIM query surface in one shot. Surfaced by bulk-probe full sweep 2026-05-12.

doors.name: 5D-EnterMsg V0.09
doors.notes: SvEN/5D 1994 message-entry helper. Exercises one more 5D-family door so we catch shared-library cleanup regressions that show up in the same 5D code patterns.

doors.name: PSY LogOff-Comment V1.0
doors.notes: Psychopath 1996 logoff/sysop-comment door. Prompt 'Do you want to leave mail to the sysop before you leave? (y/N)?' — 'n' declines and exits. Cluster representative for the 5-door PSY_LogOff.*.Xim family (000/010/020/030/040 CPU variants) surfaced by timeout-cluster mining 2026-05-12.

doors.name: WarpSearch v2.5
doors.notes: WarpSearch 2.5 — file-listing search door. Cluster representative for the 6-door 'Enter string to search for:' line-input family (WarpSearch + TurboZ variants). Bare Enter aborts search and exits. Pins the XIM line-input (JH_LI) return path on a second binary distinct from 5D-ZippySearch.

doors.name: 5D^QuickAnsi V0.05
doors.notes: 5D^QuickAnsi 0.05 — tiny 1.2 KB ANSI tester from sTc/5D. Prompt 'Choose : ->' line-input. Bare Enter exits. Cluster representative for the 7-door 5D^QuickAnsi family (cluster mined 2026-05-12 — biggest 'Choose : ->' cluster in the universe sample).

doors.name: ListSpeeder v1.2
doors.notes: Aqua ListSpeeder 1.2 — file-listing accelerator. Bare '>' prompt is a line-input read; Enter exits. Cluster representative for the 4-door ListSpeeder family (000/020/030/040 CPU variants).

doors.name: GoodBye 1.1 (DPL)
doors.notes: DPL GoodBye 1.1 (variant 'GoodBye.x'). Prompt 'Do you want to logoff or write a comment? (c/y/N)' — 'n' declines and exits. Cluster representative for the 4-door GoodBye.x family (000/020/030/040 CPU variants).

doors.name: MasterView (DPL)
doors.notes: DPL MasterView (variant 'MasterView.x'). Prompt 'Enter name of file to view :' line-input. Bare Enter aborts and exits. Cluster representative for the 4-door MasterView.x family.

doors.name: FILEID (FID15CR)
doors.notes: FILEID file-id manager (FID15CR.LHA source). Without its config the door exits via 'Error (FileId.info)' path — deterministic clean exit on bare \r. Cluster representative for the 7-door FileId family (Autosent / FILEID / AUTOSENT variants).

doors.name: WarCalls V1.2 (Humane&Vanity)
doors.notes: WarCalls 1.2 by Wardancer/Humane&Vanity. Three-stage prompt: line-input 'Enter minimum number of times online :', then JH_HK 'List ul/dl bytes... (y/N)', then JH_HK 'Would you like the output also to be copied to a file (y/N)'. Bare-CR + n + n exits clean. Cluster representative for the 5-door WarCalls family — first multi-input corpus entry.

doors.name: QuickLogon v1.0 (H&V)
doors.notes: H&V QuickLogon 1.0 — quick-logon-prompt door. Prompt 'Would you like a quick logon? (y/N)' — 'n' declines and exits. Cluster representative for the 6-door QuickLogon family (DTR/H&V variants).

doors.name: GetAnswer (HCD)
doors.notes: HCD GetAnswer. Prompt 'Enter handle/usernr >:' line-input. Bare Enter exits. Cluster representative for the 4-door GetAnswer family (HCD-GA10 + M22-GA11 CPU variants).

doors.name: AEHelp v0.4
doors.notes: AEHelp v0.4 by -= Nameless =- of Snarfs' Pub BBS. Renders the full AmiExpress command help index then prompts 'Enter command you want HELP with [press <RETURN> to quit]->'. Bare Enter exits. Cluster representative for the 4-door AEHelp family (cluster mined 2026-05-12). Longer 8 s delay because the help screen takes time to render fully before the prompt appears.
